Messages.Author: ambros...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
I've got a quick question about ousting people at the same time.

Ok here it is:

The players are a,b,c,d, I'm a. I'm at 2 blood and 3 minions, my prey(b) has
4 blood and 6 minions, his prey (c) has 3 blood and 5 minions, and his prey
(d, my pred.) has 10 blood and 4 minions. During my turn I cast a vote that
will cause all Meth's to burn blood for every minion. What happens.

1: I burn 2 and I'm out, my prey burns 4 and he's out. his prey burns 3 and
dies. and everyone but c gets points?

2: We all burn blood, and I get the points and blood for them going out?

3: we all burn blood, c's out of the game, and everyone but him gets blood and
points?

We just want to know, thanx
